title: Stainless-steel instrument cover brushing trial
titleZh: 不鏽鋼外蓋的拉絲試驗
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 | Email
From: Clara Wu, Process Engineering
To: Finishing and Planning
Subject: Thursday’s brushing trial

We want to find out whether a revised brushing recipe reduces hands-on work without changing the finish of our stainless-steel instrument covers. For the comparison, use one cover made with each recipe. Both must have been cleaned in the same load and have had their edges prepared the same way. The signed finishing traveler shows what the operator actually ran; the planning ticket shows only what was requested.

Count time spent brushing, including any extra brushing at the touch-up bench, but exclude idle time. Until Engineering signs off, send only accepted old-recipe covers to assembly. Keep accepted revised-recipe covers on the trial shelf. All rejects go to the rework bin.

A separate supply note for Raj: put six unopened packs of finishing cloths on the night crew’s cart by noon. Packs set aside for another line stay reserved until that line’s lead releases them. Cancel the rush order if you can fill the cart by noon from eligible stock already in the building. Otherwise, leave the order open.

DOCUMENT 2 | Finishing log
Thursday 11:20 a.m. | Instrument covers
Lane A uses wash rack 14; Lane B uses wash rack 15.

Cover | Lane | Edge preparation | Ticket recipe | Signed traveler | First brush | Final inspection
K61 | A | By hand | Old | Revised | 64 sec | Pass after touch-up
K62 | A | By hand | Revised | Old | 79 sec | Pass
K63 | B | By machine | Old | Old | 80 sec | Reject
K64 | A | By hand | Revised | Revised | 58 sec | Pass

Extra brushing is recorded separately by the touch-up operator.

Finishing cloths, 11:20 stock count: Eight packs on the supply shelf, all unopened. Three of those eight are reserved for Line C. None are on the night crew’s cart yet.

DOCUMENT 3 | Team chat
11:28 Leo (Wash): Rack 14 went through two loads. K64 came off before the first load so I could replace its wash tag. I put it back on that rack for the second load. The other Lane A covers were cleaned together in the first load.
11:30 Nia (Touch-up): K61 waited ten minutes to get to my bench, then I rebrushed it for 22 seconds. K62 and K64 needed no extra brushing.
11:33 Clara (Engineering): I won’t sign off today. Raj, K62 and K64 are on the assembly cart right now. K61 and K63 are on the trial shelf.
11:35 Raj (Planning): I’ll move anything that’s in the wrong place before the cart leaves at noon.
11:37 Mei (Line C lead): I’ll still need two packs. I’ve taken the Line C sticker off the third one; it’s yours now.
11:38 Receiving: The regular shipment won’t arrive until two. The rush order is still open.

文件 1｜製程工程部電郵
寄件者：製程工程部 Clara Wu
收件者：表面處理部與生產規劃部
主旨：週四拉絲試驗

我們要確認新版拉絲工法能否在維持不鏽鋼儀器外蓋表面效果的前提下，縮短實際作業時間。比較時，每個版本各用一片外蓋。兩片必須同批清洗，而且邊緣前處理方式相同。簽核過的隨工單記載人員實際採用的工法；排程單只記載原先要求的版本。

拉絲時間包含在補修台重新拉絲的時間，不含等待。工程部核准前，只有合格的舊版外蓋可送組裝。合格的新版外蓋留在試驗架。不合格品一律放進返工箱。

另有一項耗材提醒給 Raj：請在中午前將六包未拆封的表面處理擦拭布放到夜班推車上。預留給其他產線的耗材，須經該線主管同意才可動用。如果能用廠內現有的可用庫存於中午前把六包放上夜班推車，就取消急單；否則保留急單。

文件 2｜表面處理紀錄
週四 11:20｜儀器外蓋
A 線用 14 號清洗架，B 線用 15 號清洗架。

外蓋｜產線｜邊緣前處理｜排程單工法｜簽核隨工單｜首次拉絲｜最終檢驗
K61｜A｜手工｜舊版｜新版｜64 秒｜補修後合格
K62｜A｜手工｜新版｜舊版｜79 秒｜合格
K63｜B｜機器｜舊版｜舊版｜80 秒｜不合格
K64｜A｜手工｜新版｜新版｜58 秒｜合格

重新拉絲的時間由補修人員另行記錄。

表面處理擦拭布 11:20 盤點：耗材架上有八包，皆未拆封，其中三包預留給 C 線。夜班推車上目前一包都沒有。

文件 3｜工作群組訊息
11:28 Leo（清洗部）：14 號清洗架分了兩批。我在第一批前先取下 K64，以便更換清洗識別牌，再把它放回同一架跟第二批一起洗。A 線其餘外蓋都在第一批一起洗。
11:30 Nia（補修部）：K61 等了十分鐘才輪到我的工作台，我接著花了 22 秒重新拉絲。K62 和 K64 不必再拉絲。
11:33 Clara（工程部）：我今天不會核准放行。Raj，目前 K62 和 K64 在組裝推車上，K61 和 K63 在試驗架上。
11:35 Raj（生產規劃部）：我會在推車中午出發前，把放錯位置的外蓋移到正確位置。
11:37 Mei（C 線主管）：我還需要兩包。我已撕下第三包的 C 線標籤，現在你們可以拿去用。
11:38 收貨部：一般訂單要到下午兩點才會送達，急單目前還沒取消。
